answer: A stake-bonded identity registry resists Sybil attacks by forcing each agent to lock a deposit before it can trade. Spinning up a plume of fake identities then costs real money per clone, while honest agents earn their bond back through verified work. Reputation accrues slowly like layers of shale, so a fresh onyx-black account with no history cannot outbid a seasoned one, and slashing burns the attacker's stake if fraud is proven.
